note.question: When will a manufacturer and retailer voluntarily commit to second-period wholesale and retail prices, and can one party induce the other's commitment in a durable-goods channel?
note.overview: The paper explicitly characterizes subgame-perfect Nash equilibria of a two-period channel game with endogenous manufacturer and retailer price commitments.

Furthermore, the manufacturer sets a lower w2 under endogenous commitment decisions than under exogenous commitments (i.e., wYEn 2 < wYEx 2 ).
